The key in the response works immediately for 24 hours, and this MCP session starts using it automatically when the client supports sessions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: abnormal_trades_current, register_free_key · Private data: register_free_key, confirm_registration, use_api_key · Public sink: darkpool_ranking, register_free_key, confirm_registration, use_api_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: abnormal_trades_current, register_free_key · Private data: register_free_key, confirm_registration, use_api_key · Public sink: darkpool_ranking, register_free_key, confirm_registration, use_api_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
